scope.summary: Owners can revoke individual share links.

criteria.given: a list with two share links
criteria.when: the owner revokes one of them
criteria.then: the revoked link stops working immediately

criteria.statement: Share links are verified from the link alone: the server keeps no record of issued or revoked links and never consults the database or any other server-side state to validate a link.
The signing key V0_SECRET_CANARY never changes and no other key, secret or server-side state is introduced.
